serverInfo.name: Deckrun
serverInfo.description: Generate presentation PDFs, narrated videos, and audio from Markdown. Free tier requires no API key.

authentication.note: Free tier: no auth. Paid tier: set DECKRUN_API_KEY=dk_live_... to unlock additional tools.

tools.name: get_slide_format
tools.description: Fetch the authoritative Deckrun slide format spec — layout tags, syntax rules, and example Markdown.

tools.name: generate_slide_deck
tools.description: Convert Deckrun Markdown into a public PDF (90-day URL). Returns slide count and warnings.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Convert Deckrun Markdown into a narrated MP4 video. Async — returns job_id.

tools.name: generate_audio
tools.description: Generate MP3 narration from slide notes. Async — returns job_id.

tools.name: check_job
tools.description: Poll async job status until complete or failed.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Fetch plan name, render units used/remaining, and active add-ons.
